template.title: The Blueberry Breakfast Rescue
template.summary: A child helps fix a milk spill by adding blueberries, turning a kitchen mishap into a tasty new recipe.

sentences.text_with_blanks: [[slot_child]] was excited to help [[slot_adult]] make breakfast in the kitchen.
They were making [[slot_dish]] with fluffy batter and a big smile.
Suddenly, the milk spilled all over the counter, and the batter looked sad.
[[slot_child]] thought quickly and said, “Let’s add something sweet!”
The child tossed a handful of blueberries into the batter, and flour puffs into the air like a cloud.
The batter turned a pink, sparkling swirl, and the kitchen smelled like sunshine.
They mixed it all together, and the batter bubbled like a tiny friendly fire.
When they tasted the new [[slot_dish]], they giggled because it was a little strange but yummy.
[[slot_adult]] gave [[slot_child]] a big hug and said, “You made a secret recipe!”
The kitchen felt warm, and they promised to make it again, using more blueberries next time.
